#### B. The two extended policies of this task

**`savings_ext_excess_fee_review_credit` — baseline.** Computation document
`fee_review_credit_basis_4bb5da07` (role `baseline`). The source `baseline.rule` is carried sentence for
sentence: one entry for the whole review, booked against the most recently posted excess withdrawal fee; the
reviewable fee pool as the one calendar month's excess withdrawal fees; one fee unit and the entitlement as
units × the tier's excess withdrawal fee; the credit before any ceiling as the lesser of pool and
entitlement; the 60.00 USD review ceiling with "the fee units alone govern the credit booked"; the floor at
zero. The three `baseline.params` are reachable: `excess_withdrawal_fee` by name in
`withdrawal_allowance_schedule_a5a0e3f5` (10.00 USD on Premier Money Market), `fee_units_standard` (1) and
`review_ceiling_standard` (60.00) stated in the document. Nothing added.

Its four factors, each carried whole in its own document, none referencing another:

| factor | document | ladder check |
|---|---|---|
| `reviewable_pool_width` (method) | `reviewable_fee_pool_width_005a9684` | 6+ purchases **and** ≥ 3000 points → twelve calendar months' excess withdrawal fees; 3–5 **and** ≥ 3000 → three calendar months'; <3 **or** < 3000 → one calendar month's. Both limbs of both compound conditions in figures; the "3000 points / 2999 does not" boundary stated |
| `covered_unit_count` (parameter) | `covered_fee_unit_count_4066fd61` | 5+ fee entries **and** ≤ 36 whole months → 3 units; 3–4 **and** ≤ 36 → 2 units; <3 **or** > 36 → 1 unit. The "both conditions bind" limb and the 36/37-month boundary stated |
| `review_ceiling_step` (parameter) | `fee_review_ceiling_step_1b3a0a04` | ledger < 5000.00 **and** DD < 1000.00 → 24.00; ledger < 5000.00 **and** DD ≥ 1000.00 → 18.00; ledger ≥ 5000.00 → 60.00. Boundaries at 5000.00/4999.99 and 1000.00/999.99 stated |
| `ceiling_bite_moment` (method) | `fee_review_ceiling_application_point_7257447a` | 4+ withdrawals → the ceiling binds the pool **before** the units; 2–3 → it binds the credit **after** the units; <2 → the units alone govern. The moment the cap bites, which is the whole content of this factor, is pinned exactly for all three tiers |

**`savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount` — baseline.** Computation document
`surplus_transfer_amount_basis_86e431d1`. Carries: the settled balance (deposits + interest credits + fee
refunds − withdrawals − fees, floored at zero); "The available balance is the settled balance" (the
`replaced_by` of its override); the balance to retain as the tier's minimum daily balance waiver threshold;
the surplus as available less retained, floored at zero, with "the whole surplus is moved" and "No
withdrawal already posted is set against it"; the amount moved rounded half up to the cent, never less than
100.00 USD and never more than the 5000.00 USD transfer ceiling. The four `baseline.params` are reachable:
`waiver_min_daily_balance` in `maintenance_fee_and_waiver_schedule_edc36e5b` (10000.00 USD on Premier Money
Market, as the lowest end-of-day balance column), and `share_standard`, `ceiling_standard` and
`minimum_transfer` stated in the document.

Its six factors, each whole, each in its own document:

|---|---|---|

Boundaries at 2000.00/1999.99 and exactly 10000 points stated |
| `retained_balance_cushion` (parameter) | `surplus_retained_balance_8e80e7a4` | ledger < 2500.00 **and** DD < 1000.00 → threshold + 5000.00; ledger < 2500.00 **and** DD ≥ 1000.00 → threshold + 2000.00; ledger ≥ 2500.00 → threshold |
| `moved_surplus_share` (parameter) | `share_of_surplus_moved_12ef1f90` | 3+ withdrawals **and** ≤ 36 whole months → 0.75; exactly 2 **and** ≤ 36 → 0.90; <2 **or** > 36 → the whole surplus |
| `recent_withdrawal_offset` (method) | `recent_withdrawal_offset_against_surplus_e66a4b04` | ≥ 2000.00 of withdrawals → reduce by them up to a 1000.00 ceiling, never below zero; ≥ 500.00 and < 2000.00 → up to a 400.00 ceiling; < 500.00 → nothing set against the surplus. | `moved_amount_rounding` (method) | `moved_amount_rounding_standard_176b6ced` | 3+ interest entries → half up to the whole dollar; 1–2 → truncated to the whole hundred dollars; 0 → half up to the cent. Mode and precision exact, with a worked figure showing truncation is not rounding |

#### C. The retired surface

The eight `overwrite` entries and their six distinct superseded clauses are enumerated in this difficulty's
task 0 file, §C, with the bearing document and the retiring words for each; the finding there — every
retired clause borne exactly once and written as retired, nothing over-retired, all unnamed clauses still in
force — applies to this corpus and so to this task. The two that bear on this task directly:

- `savings_ext_excess_fee_review_credit` supersedes `savings_evt_fee_refund`'s "A fee is refunded in full,
  never in part, as one savings_fee_refund row whose source_item_id is the fee row." This is the *same*
  clause `savings_ext_periodic_fee_courtesy_credit` supersedes, and the corpus retires it **once**, in
  `fee_refund_grounds_and_courtesy_limits_4cb0dd10` — not once per overriding policy. That is the correct
  handling: the clause is the object, not the override.
- `savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount` supersedes `savings_evt_deposits`'s "A deposit posts on the business
  day its funds become available, so the current balance is also the available balance", retired in
  `deposit_posting_and_availability_284e915f` under "### No longer in force", and replaced by "The available
  balance is the settled balance" in `surplus_transfer_amount_basis_86e431d1`. The two readings cannot be
  confused: the retired clause equated the available balance with the *current* balance, the surviving one
  with the *settled* balance, and the holdback factor then reduces it.

The three specific establishments the brief asked for — the retired allocation wording single-homed with no
paraphrase anywhere, the bonus basis netted once in two named stages, and the retired per-fee window reading
only as retired while the surviving counting convention cannot re-impose it — are recorded with their
evidence in this difficulty's task 0 file, §C, items 1–3. All three hold.

### bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Every normative atom of `savings_ext_excess_fee_review_credit` and
`savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount`, of the base policies governing their subjects, and of the six
variants' parameters has an equivalent prose home; both baselines are carried complete with their own
default constants and every product figure they read named and rendered; all ten declared factors of these
two policies carry their whole ladders — every tier, both limbs of every compound condition, every threshold
in figures, and for the method tiers the operation, base, rounding mode, precision, moment and order of
steps — in their own documents, none referencing another; the retired surface is borne exactly once per
clause and written as retired; and the single prerequisite sentence stands verbatim, in its declared `state`
form, in a document of the policy it blocks and in no other policy's.

#### Policy-side note (recorded, and not counted against this verdict)

The order in which `moved_surplus_share` and `recent_withdrawal_offset` apply to the surplus is not stated
in business words by either factor. Both name the same operand:
`share_of_surplus_moved_12ef1f90` — *"three quarters of **the surplus** is moved"*;
`recent_withdrawal_offset_against_surplus_e66a4b04` — *"**the surplus** is reduced by those withdrawals up to
a ceiling of 1000.00 USD"*. What actually fixes the order on the source side is the factor's `baseline`
binding `offset_surplus: paced_surplus` — the offset operates on the *paced* surplus — and `baseline` is an
authoring field with no home in any document. The source's `rule` prose has the same property, saying only
"the surplus is reduced by those withdrawals", so the documents are a faithful carry and the
under-determination is the charter's, not the rendering's. What resolves it for a reader is the baseline
document's own clause order — *"The surplus is the available balance less the balance the account must
retain, taken as no less than zero, and the whole surplus is moved. No withdrawal already posted is set
against it."* — share, then offset, which is the order the compute applies and which the companion
computation `standing_transfer_amount_basis_7bd70d0b` observes as well (offset inside the shortfall
sentence, division after it). The blind audit reached the other order and so reached 16780.00 instead of
16530.00; see `runtime_context/.../1.md` for the trace. Practical weight: 250.00 USD on this task. Reported
here as a charter-side observation; per this skill's discipline it does not change the verdict, and no
change to either side is proposed.
